program.name: Classical Mat
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: The classical mat order from the hundred to the seal, alternating with a day that focuses on part of it.
program.about: The classical Pilates mat order, from the hundred to the seal. One day runs the order itself, in two series; the other keeps the opening and closing and spends its middle on abs, rolling, back or sides. Moving from one exercise to the next without stopping is part of the method. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder versions, like the teaser in place of the roll-up. Suits you once the basics feel familiar.
program.split: The classical order / order with a focus
